parent_jurisdiction: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha (UK Overseas Territory)
next_action: Obtain written Ascension Island Government confirmation of the Bangladesh ordinary-passport nationality selector result and the multi-entry UK visa condition before creating a Bangladesh tourism requirement.
notes: AIG confirms a separate visitor eVisa and no visa-on-arrival facility. Visitor stay is up to three months per stay and no more than three cumulative months in any 12-month period. The 2026 visitor fee is GBP 40 standard or GBP 60 fast track; under-12 fee is GBP 10. The portal aims to determine 90 percent of applications within 21 days and complex cases can take up to six weeks. The official portal says a clear-face JPEG upload is required and does not specify fixed dimensions; this does not establish that no printed photo can ever be requested. Bangladesh is absent from the published no-issue nationality list, but the live ordinary-passport nationality selector result was not captured. Bangladesh is on the current UK visa-national list, and Ascension says a multi-entry UK visa valid for outward and return journeys may be required unless travel is via the Falkland Islands. Keep research-only; no Bangladesh tourism requirement is created.
